summary: Validator protocol and result models. Defines ValidationIssue (severity/category/message), ValidationReport (with computed errors/warnings properties and domain counters), and the Validator runtime-checkable protocol.
public_api: ValidationIssue(severity: 'error'|'warning'|'info', category: str, message: str, details?: dict)
ValidationReport(is_valid, issues, input_row_count?, output_row_count?, exact_match?, fragment_count?, combination_count?, conflict_count, coverage_gap_count, orphan_count)
extension_points: Validator protocol — implement to add new validation checks
lifecycle_notes: ValidationReport has domain-specific counters (conflict_count, coverage_gap_count, orphan_count) that correspond to planned validators
documentation_hooks: Extension author guide — how to implement a Validator
